_about: Fixes for LIHockey.com box scores that are wrong. .github/scripts/pull_lihockey.py applies these on every pull, to the game's box score and to the season totals. Key: team, then LIHockey game id (lihockey.com/games/<id>/). Per player, give the correct goals (g), assists (a) and/or penalty minutes (pim); points are worked out. Remove an entry once LIHockey fixes the game.

5862.note: Corrected by the team: Matthew Grosskurth scored 2 goals and Jorge Leonardo none (LIHockey had 1 each).
